description: Stage 3b shared frame-convergence. Section cases: stable accepted growth at the requested origin learns a conservative minimum and changes the next tiled target; a contradictory declared maximum never learns; refused/throwing setters hold on the transient backoff with no learning and retry controlled past it; exact re-observation of the learned target converges with the floor retained. Section replacement_cases: a retired token reused as a fresh native lifetime never inherits suppression or floors. Section observation_cases: incomplete, hidden, and unreadable observations record no invented proof, then recovery observations converge as tabled. Core runners mirror the exact seam capture facts: the flagged report carries the pre-flag raw attempt (accepted setter, grown readback, attempt_ms 1000) with incomplete staging every fact unreadable on incomplete screens, hidden staging a minimized fact on a complete inventory, and unreadable staging w1 unreadable on complete screens with an incomplete inventory; recovery re-observes the tabled rect on a complete inventory. One oracle per lane, asserted identically by core and seam: incomplete holds incomplete-inventory with the clamp pair recorded and clears exact on the baseline recovery; hidden holds minimized with nothing recorded and converges controlled on the grown recovery; unreadable holds unreadable with the clamp pair recorded and re-holds clamp on the grown recovery. Neither runner learns bounds without proof. Section settlement_cases: a partially-arrived migration holds its operation, then full arrival completes to the source refill. Core (world_frame_policy_tests, world_migration_refusal_tests) and Windows production sequencing (world_diff_tests) consume the SAME sections with separate runners; every Windows growth/arrival fact is produced by the real native seam (clamp/fail/throw/membership) and only emitted raw attempts ride the sequencer, never a handbuilt echo. Observation conditions (failed enumeration, hidden facts, identity drift, close/re-admit) are scripted through the real capture path; the no-seam-knob claim applies to attempts only. Offline-only predicates (DPI rescale, fixed-size) stay in direct core tests, as do minimized/hidden native claim lanes beyond the capture facts used here.
